```{r}
#match metabolites between metabolic dataset and mv loadings
known <- mv6_loadings_nna_unk_sig[,1] #mv6
metabolites <- metab$Metabolites

# Safe parsing function
parse_entry_safe <- function(entry) {
  entry <- iconv(entry, to = "UTF-8", sub = "byte")
  parts <- unlist(strsplit(entry, "_"))
  if (length(parts) < 3) return(NULL)
  
  name <- paste0(parts[1:(length(parts) - 2)], collapse = "_")
  mass <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts[length(parts) - 1]))
  rt <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts[length(parts)]))
  
  if (is.na(mass) || is.na(rt)) return(NULL)
  
  return(list(name = gsub("[[:punct:]]", "", name), mass = mass, rt = rt))
}

# Parse known and metabolites
known_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(known, parse_entry_safe))
metabolites_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(metabolites, parse_entry_safe))

# Convert to data frames
known_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, known_list), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
metabolites_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, metabolites_list), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Ensure numeric
known_df$mass <- as.numeric(known_df$mass)
known_df$rt <- as.numeric(known_df$rt)
metabolites_df$mass <- as.numeric(metabolites_df$mass)
metabolites_df$rt <- as.numeric(metabolites_df$rt)

# Thresholds
delta_mass <- 0.02
delta_rt <- 0.1

# Find matching indices in metabolites for each known
matched_indices <- sapply(1:nrow(known_df), function(i) {
  matches <- which(abs(known_df$mass[i] - metabolites_df$mass) <= delta_mass &
                   abs(known_df$rt[i] - metabolites_df$rt) <= delta_rt)
  if (length(matches) > 0) return(matches[1]) else return(NA)
})

# Output: indices of first match for each known in metabolites
print(matched_indices)


head(metab[matched_indices,1:5])

metab_matched <- metab[matched_indices,]
dim(metab_matched)
```

```{r}
#linear regression
# Ensure ggrepel is installed
#if (!require("ggrepel")) install.packages("ggrepel")
library(ggrepel)

# Convert PNI to binary
metab_clin$PNI <- metab_clin$status_relapse

# Identify metabolite columns
start_col <- which(names(metab_clin) == "2-Ethylhydracrylic acid_118.06_2.84") #MV6
metabolite_cols <- start_col:ncol(metab_clin)

# Run models
results <- data.frame(Metabolite = character(), Estimate = numeric(), P_value = numeric())

for (met in names(metab_clin)[metabolite_cols]) {
  model <- lm(metab_clin[[met]] ~ metab_clin$PNI)
  sm <- summary(model)
  est <- coef(sm)[2, "Estimate"]
  pval <- coef(sm)[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Metabolite = met, Estimate = est, P_value = pval))
}

# Add logP and significance
results$logP <- -log10(results$P_value)
results$Significant <- results$P_value < 0.05

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
# Volcano plot with labels
ggplot(results, aes(x = Estimate, y = logP, color = Significant)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(results, Significant == TRUE),
    aes(label = Metabolite),
    size = 3.2,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Effect size (Estimate)",
    y = expression(-log[10](p)),
    title = "Metabolite Association with PNI"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "gray70", "TRUE" = "firebrick")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

#boxplot
boxplot(as.numeric(unlist(metab_clin[,metabolite_cols[6]])) ~ metab_clin$status_relapse)
kruskal.test(as.numeric(unlist(metab_clin[,metabolite_cols[6]])) ~ metab_clin$status_relapse)
```

```{r}
#run 1000 iterations of resampling 70% training and 30% test samples from 177 samples

library(ggrepel)
set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility

# Convert PNI to binary
metab_clin$PNI <- metab_clin$status_relapse

# Identify metabolite columns
start_col <- which(names(metab_clin) == "2-Ethylhydracrylic acid_118.06_2.84") #MV6
metabolite_cols <- start_col:ncol(metab_clin)
metabolite_names <- names(metab_clin)[metabolite_cols]

# Initialize results storage
sig_counts <- setNames(rep(0, length(metabolite_names)), metabolite_names)

# Run 1000 iterations
for (i in 1:10) {
  # Split data into 70% training, 30% testing
  idx <- sample(1:nrow(metab_clin), size = 0.7 * nrow(metab_clin))
  train <- metab_clin[idx, ]
  
  for (met in metabolite_names) {
    model <- lm(train[[met]] ~ train$PNI)
    sm <- summary(model)
    pval <- coef(sm)[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]
    
    if (!is.na(pval) && pval < 0.05) {
      sig_counts[met] <- sig_counts[met] + 1
    }
  }
}

# Convert to data frame and sort
sig_df <- data.frame(
  Metabolite = names(sig_counts),
  Frequency = as.numeric(sig_counts)
)
sig_df <- sig_df[order(-sig_df$Frequency), ]

# View top metabolites
head(sig_df, 10)

#generate the frequency bar plot
# Reorder factors by frequency
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
sig_df_filtered <- sig_df %>%
  filter(Metabolite != "PNI") %>%
  mutate(Percentage = 100 * Frequency / 1000)

# Reorder factors by percentage
sig_df_filtered$Metabolite <- factor(sig_df_filtered$Metabolite, levels = sig_df_filtered$Metabolite[order(sig_df_filtered$Percentage, decreasing = TRUE)])


# Plot

#pdf("20250413_COLOSSUS_phenmap_RELAPSE_MV6_metabolite_ass#ociation_1000_iterations_frequency_plot.pdf")
ggplot(sig_df_filtered, aes(x = Metabolite, y = Percentage)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Percentage of Times Metabolites Were Significant (1000 runs)",
       x = "Metabolite", y = "Percentage (%)") +
  theme_minimal()
#dev.off()
```

```{r}
#save effect sizes
# Initialize
# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(303)

# Convert PNI to binary
# Convert PNI to binary
metab_clin$PNI <- metab_clin$status_relapse

# Define metabolite columns
start_col <- which(names(metab_clin) == "2-Ethylhydracrylic acid_118.06_2.84") #MV6
metabolite_names <- names(metab_clin)[start_col:ncol(metab_clin)]

# Exclude PNI from the metabolite list
metabolite_names <- setdiff(metabolite_names, "PNI")

# Initialize results storage
all_results <- data.frame(
  Iteration = integer(),
  Metabolite = character(),
  Estimate = numeric(),
  P_value = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Track warnings
perfect_fit_count <- 0
warning_metabolites <- character()

# Run 1000 iterations
for (i in 1:1000) {
  idx <- sample(1:nrow(metab_clin), size = 0.7 * nrow(metab_clin))
  train <- metab_clin[idx, ]
  
  for (met in metabolite_names) {
    model <- lm(train[[met]] ~ train$PNI)
    
    sm <- withCallingHandlers(
      summary(model),
      warning = function(w) {
        if (grepl("essentially perfect fit", w$message)) {
          perfect_fit_count <<- perfect_fit_count + 1
          warning_metabolites <<- c(warning_metabolites, met)
        }
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    )
    
    if (!is.na(coef(sm)[2, "Pr(>|t|)"])) {
      est <- coef(sm)[2, "Estimate"]
      pval <- coef(sm)[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]
      
      
      all_results <- rbind(all_results, data.frame(
        Iteration = i,
        Metabolite = met,
        Estimate = est,
        P_value = pval
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Report total warning count
cat("Number of 'essentially perfect fit' warnings:", perfect_fit_count, "\n")

# Summarize results
summary_df <- all_results %>%
  group_by(Metabolite) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Estimate = mean(Estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Estimate = sd(Estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_logP = mean(-log10(P_value), na.rm = TRUE),
    Freq_Sig = mean(P_value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Significance_Level = case_when(
    Freq_Sig > 0.2 ~ ">20%",
    Freq_Sig > 0.1 ~ "10–20%",
    TRUE ~ "<=10%"
  ))

# Fix encoding and clean names
summary_df$Metabolite <- iconv(summary_df$Metabolite, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "byte")
summary_df$Clean_Name <- sub("_.*", "", summary_df$Metabolite)
summary_df$Clean_Name <- str_wrap(summary_df$Clean_Name, width = 20)

# Plot with horizontal line at 0
#pdf("20250513_COLOSSUS_phenmap_RELAPSE_MV6_metabolite_association_1000_iterations.pdf")
ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = reorder(Clean_Name, Mean_Estimate), y = Mean_Estimate, color = Significance_Level)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_point(aes(size = Freq_Sig)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_Estimate - SD_Estimate, ymax = Mean_Estimate + SD_Estimate), width = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Metabolite Effects on PNI (1000 Iterations)",
    x = "Metabolite", y = "Mean Linear Estimate",
    size = "Significance Frequency", color = "Significance Level"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(">20%" = "firebrick", "10–20%" = "orange", "<=10%" = "gray60")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))
#dev.off()

# selected metabolites
sel <- which(summary_df$Significance_Level == "10–20%" | summary_df$Significance_Level == ">20%")

mm <- match(summary_df$Metabolite[sel], metab_matched$Metabolites)
metab_matched_sel <- metab_matched[mm,]
dim(metab_matched_sel)
```

```{r}

# repeated 1000 times  # proteins ~ PNI+metabolites
# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(42)

# Ensure ggrepel is installed
#if (!require("ggrepel")) install.packages("ggrepel")
library(ggrepel)

# Convert PNI to binary
metab_clin_sel$PNI <- ifelse(tolower(metab_clin_sel$perineural_invasion) == "yes", 1, 0)


protein_exp <- read.delim("20200928_metabolomics_median_replicates_data_80_Non_zero_sample_median_centred_imputed_MARS_combat_lysis_batch.txt", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dim(protein_exp)

ssdp <- apply(protein_exp,1,sd)
w_ssdp <- which(ssdp > 0)
length(w_ssdp)

protein_exp_sd <- protein_exp[w_ssdp,]
dim(protein_exp_sd)

# 1. Transpose protein matrix: make samples rows, proteins columns
protein_long <- as.data.frame(t(protein_exp_sd))
protein_long$sample_id <- rownames(protein_long)

# 2. Fix sample ID format to match metab_clin_sel$COLOSSUS_ID
# If protein colnames are like COL.268.R.001_FP_001, convert to COL-268-R-001
protein_long$COLOSSUS_ID <- gsub("\\.", "-", gsub("_FP_.*", "", protein_long$sample_id))

# 3. Subset metabolite columns of interest
selected_mets <- c(
  "Dodecanoic acid_200.18.2.92", 
  "Myristic acid_228.21_2.92",
  "2-Ethylhydracrylic acid_118.06_3.59"
)

met_cols <- grep(paste(selected_mets, collapse = "|"), colnames(metab_clin_sel), value = TRUE)

# 4. Merge protein expression with clinical/metabolite data
combined_data <- merge(protein_long, metab_clin_sel[, c("COLOSSUS_ID", "status_relapse", met_cols)], by = "COLOSSUS_ID")

# 5. Get protein and metabolite column names
protein_names <- setdiff(colnames(protein_long), c("sample_id", "COLOSSUS_ID"))
metabolite_names <- met_cols

# 6. Create grid of protein-metabolite combinations
model_grid <- expand.grid(protein = protein_names, metabolite = metabolite_names, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Number of resampling iterations
n_iter <- 1000

# Threshold for significance (e.g., p < 0.05)
p_thresh <- 0.05

# Track hits
library(dplyr)
library(parallel)
# Initialize tracking structures
interaction_hits <- matrix(0, nrow = length(protein_names), ncol = length(metabolite_names),
                           dimnames = list(protein_names, metabolite_names))
all_results_list <- list()

# Main resampling loop
for (i in 1:n_iter) {
  cat("Iteration:", i, "\n")
  
  # Split data (70% train)
  train_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(combined_data)), size = floor(0.7 * nrow(combined_data)))
  train_data <- combined_data[train_idx, ]
  
  iter_results <- list()
  
  for (protein in protein_names) {
    for (metabolite in metabolite_names) {
      df <- train_data[, c(protein, "status_relapse", metabolite)]
      colnames(df) <- c("protein_val", "status_relapse", "met_val")
      
      df$protein_val <- as.numeric(df$protein_val)
      df$status_relapse <- as.numeric(df$status_relapse)
      df$met_val <- as.numeric(df$met_val)
      
      df <- df[complete.cases(df) & is.finite(df$protein_val) & is.finite(df$met_val), ]
      if (nrow(df) < 5) next
      
      model <- tryCatch(lm(protein_val ~ status_relapse * met_val, data = df), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(model)) next
      
      summ <- summary(model)$coefficients
      if ("status_relapse:met_val" %in% rownames(summ)) {
        pval <- summ["status_relapse:met_val", "Pr(>|t|)"]
        est  <- summ["status_relapse:met_val", "Estimate"]
        r2   <- summary(model)$r.squared
        
        if (!is.na(pval) && pval < p_thresh) {
          interaction_hits[protein, metabolite] <- interaction_hits[protein, metabolite] + 1
          
          iter_results[[length(iter_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
            iteration = i,
            protein = protein,
            metabolite = metabolite,
            estimate_interaction = est,
            pval_interaction = pval,
            r_squared = r2,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (length(iter_results) > 0) {
    all_results_list[[i]] <- do.call(rbind, iter_results)
  }
}

# Combine all iterations
all_results <- do.call(rbind, all_results_list)

# Compute frequency of significance
interaction_freq <- interaction_hits / n_iter

# Summarize average results
library(dplyr)
summary_stats <- all_results %>%
```

```{r}
library(interactions)

plot_interaction_with_p <- function(data, gene_col, pni_col, metabolite_col) {
  # Rename columns internally for convenience
  data$Gene <- data[[gene_col]]
  data$PNI <- data[[pni_col]]
  data$Metabolite <- data[[metabolite_col]]
  
  # Fit interaction model
  lm_formula <- as.formula("Gene ~ PNI * Metabolite")
  lm_result <- lm(lm_formula, data = data)
  
  # Extract interaction p-value
  interaction_term <- grep("PNI:Metabolite", rownames(summary(lm_result)$coefficients), value = TRUE)
  interaction_p <- summary(lm_result)$coefficients[interaction_term, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  p_label <- paste0("Interaction p = ", signif(interaction_p, 3))
  
  # Create plot
  library(ggplot2)
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Metabolite, y = Gene, color = as.factor(PNI))) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Interaction Between PNI and", metabolite_col, "on", gene_col),
      x = metabolite_col,
      y = gene_col,
      color = "PNI"
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = p_label, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 5) +
    theme_minimal()
}

plot_interaction_with_p(
  data = combined_data,
  gene_col = "Q9HC84_MUC5B",
  pni_col = "status_relapse",
  metabolite_col = "Myristic acid_228.21_2.92"
)
```

```{r}
#positive proteins for postive metabolites of PNI enrichment - network plot
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(msigdbr)
library(enrichplot)
library(dplyr)

# --------------------------------------------
# Step 2: Read Gene Symbols from File
# --------------------------------------------
#gene_file <- "20250514_COLOSSUS_positive_proteins_relapse_metabolites_interactions_1000_iterations.txt"

gene_file <- "20250514_COLOSSUS_negative_proteins_relapse_metabolites_interactions_1000_iterations.txt"
gene_symbols <- scan(gene_file, what = "character", sep = "\n")

# --------------------------------------------
# Step 3: Convert SYMBOL to ENTREZ and Map Back
# --------------------------------------------
gene_df <- bitr(gene_symbols,
                fromType = "SYMBOL",
                toType = "ENTREZID",
                OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

cat("Mapped genes:", nrow(gene_df), "of", length(gene_symbols), "\n")

# --------------------------------------------
# Step 4: Load Hallmark Gene Sets (MSigDB category H)
# --------------------------------------------
#library(qusage)
#hallmark_sets <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2", subcategory = "CP:REACTOME")
hallmark_sets <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H")
term2gene <- hallmark_sets[, c("gs_name", "entrez_gene")]


# --------------------------------------------
# Step 5: Perform Enrichment (Initial Wide Filter)
# --------------------------------------------
enrich_result_all <- enricher(gene = gene_df$ENTREZID,
                              TERM2GENE = term2gene,
                              pvalueCutoff = 1)  # Capture all, filter later

# --------------------------------------------
# Step 6: Filter by FDR (adjusted p-value)
# --------------------------------------------
# Keep terms with FDR < 0.1
enrich_result_all@result <- enrich_result_all@result %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.1)

cat("Terms passing FDR < 0.1:", nrow(enrich_result_all@result), "\n")

# --------------------------------------------
# Step 7: Replace Entrez IDs with Gene Symbols
# --------------------------------------------
entrez_to_symbol <- setNames(gene_df$SYMBOL, gene_df$ENTREZID)

enrich_result_all@result$geneID <- sapply(strsplit(enrich_result_all@result$geneID, "/"), function(ids) {
  paste(entrez_to_symbol[ids], collapse = "/")
})

# --------------------------------------------
# Step 8: Plot Network with Gene Symbols
# --------------------------------------------
#pdf("20250514_COLOSSUS_positive_proteins_relapse_metabolite_interaction_1000_iterations_HALLMARK_network_plot.pdf")
if (nrow(enrich_result_all@result) > 0) {
  cnetplot(enrich_result_all,
           showCategory = min(15, nrow(enrich_result_all@result)),  # plot up to 15 terms
           circular = FALSE,
           node_label = "all",
           color.params = list(edge = TRUE)) +
    ggtitle("Hallmark Enrichment Network (FDR < 0.01)") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")  # remove right-side category legend
} else {
  cat("No enriched terms passed FDR < 0.01.\n")
}
#dev.off()
```

```{r}
# repeated 1000 times  # proteins ~ PNI+metabolites
# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(42)

# Ensure ggrepel is installed
#if (!require("ggrepel")) install.packages("ggrepel")
library(ggrepel)

# Convert PNI to binary
#metab_clin_sel$status_relapse <- ifelse(tolower(metab_clin_sel$perineural_invasion) == "yes", 1, 0)


protein_exp_r <- read.delim("20200803_Colossus_RPPA_datasheet_June15_normalized_data_Jochen.txt", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = 1)
dim(protein_exp_r)

ssdp_r <- apply(protein_exp_r,1,sd)
w_ssdp_r <- which(ssdp_r > 0)
length(w_ssdp_r)

protein_exp_sd_r <- protein_exp_r[w_ssdp_r,]
dim(protein_exp_sd_r)

# 1. Transpose protein matrix: make samples rows, proteins columns
protein_long_r <- as.data.frame(t(protein_exp_sd_r))
protein_long_r$sample_id <- rownames(protein_long_r)

# 2. Fix sample ID format to match metab_clin_sel$COLOSSUS_ID
# If protein colnames are like COL.268.R.001_FP_001, convert to COL-268-R-001
protein_long_r$COLOSSUS_ID <- gsub("\\.", "-", protein_long_r$sample_id)

# 3. Subset metabolite columns of interest
selected_mets_r <- c(
  "Dodecanoic acid_200.18.2.92", 
  "Myristic acid_228.21_2.92",
  "2-Ethylhydracrylic acid_118.06_3.59"
)

met_cols_r <- grep(paste(selected_mets_r, collapse = "|"), colnames(metab_clin_sel), value = TRUE)

# 4. Merge protein expression with clinical/metabolite data
combined_data_r <- merge(protein_long_r, metab_clin_sel[, c("COLOSSUS_ID", "status_relapse", met_cols_r)], by = "COLOSSUS_ID")

# 5. Get protein and metabolite column names
protein_names_r <- setdiff(colnames(protein_long_r), c("sample_id", "COLOSSUS_ID"))
metabolite_names_r <- met_cols_r

# 6. Create grid of protein-metabolite combinations
model_grid_r <- expand.grid(protein = protein_names_r, metabolite = metabolite_names_r, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Number of resampling iterations
n_iter_r <- 1000

# Threshold for significance (e.g., p < 0.05)
p_thresh_r <- 0.05

# Track hits
library(dplyr)
library(parallel)
# Initialize tracking structures
interaction_hits_r <- matrix(0, nrow = length(protein_names_r), ncol = length(metabolite_names_r),
                           dimnames = list(protein_names_r, metabolite_names_r))
all_results_list_r <- list()

# Main resampling loop
for (i in 1:n_iter_r) {
  cat("Iteration:", i, "\n")
  
  # Split data (70% train)
  train_idx_r <- sample(seq_len(nrow(combined_data_r)), size = floor(0.7 * nrow(combined_data_r)))
  train_data_r <- combined_data_r[train_idx_r, ]
  
  iter_results_r <- list()
  
  for (protein in protein_names_r) {
    for (metabolite in metabolite_names_r) {
      df_r <- train_data_r[, c(protein, "status_relapse", metabolite)]
      colnames(df_r) <- c("protein_val_r", "status_relapse", "met_val_r")
      
      df_r$protein_val_r <- as.numeric(df_r$protein_val_r)
      df_r$status_relapse <- as.numeric(df_r$status_relapse)
      df_r$met_val_r <- as.numeric(df_r$met_val_r)
      
      df_r <- df_r[complete.cases(df_r) & is.finite(df_r$protein_val_r) & is.finite(df_r$met_val_r), ]
      if (nrow(df_r) < 5) next
      
      model_r <- tryCatch(lm(protein_val_r ~ status_relapse * met_val_r, data = df_r), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(model_r)) next
      
      summ_r <- summary(model_r)$coefficients
      if ("status_relapse:met_val_r" %in% rownames(summ_r)) {
        pval_r <- summ_r["status_relapse:met_val_r", "Pr(>|t|)"]
        est_r  <- summ_r["status_relapse:met_val_r", "Estimate"]
        r2_r  <- summary(model_r)$r.squared
        
        if (!is.na(pval_r) && pval_r < p_thresh_r) {
          interaction_hits_r[protein, metabolite] <- interaction_hits_r[protein, metabolite] + 1
          
          iter_results_r[[length(iter_results_r) + 1]] <- data.frame(
            iteration_r = i,
            protein_r = protein,
            metabolite_r = metabolite,
            estimate_interaction_r = est_r,
            pval_interaction_r = pval_r,
            r_squared_r = r2_r,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (length(iter_results_r) > 0) {
    all_results_list_r[[i]] <- do.call(rbind, iter_results_r)
  }
}

# Combine all iterations
all_results_r <- do.call(rbind, all_results_list_r)

# Compute frequency of significance
interaction_freq_r <- interaction_hits_r / n_iter_r

# Summarize average results
summary_stats_r <- all_results_r %>%
  group_by(protein_r, metabolite_r) %>%
  summarise(
    n_hits_r = n(),
    mean_estimate_interaction_r = mean(estimate_interaction_r, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pval_interaction_r = mean(pval_interaction_r, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_r_squared_r = mean(r_squared_r, na.rm = TRUE),
    frequency_r = n_hits_r / n_iter_r,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(frequency_r >= 0.5)  # raise to 0.9 for stricter selection

# View or save summary
print(summary_stats_r)
# write.table(summary_stats_r, "20250514_COLOSSUS_protein_metabolite_RELAPSE_interaction_1000_times_summary_RPPA_data.txt", row.names = FALSE, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)

#density plot
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Basic density plot of number of hits
#pdf("20250512_COLOSSUS_PNI_metabolites_protein_1000_iterations_density_plot_RPPA_Data.pdf")
ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = n_hits)) +
  geom_density(fill = "#67a9cf", alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Density of Significant Interaction Counts (n_hits)",
    subtitle = "Across 1000 resampling iterations",
    x = "Number of significant hits (n_hits)",
    y = "Density"
  )
#dev.off()

# histogram
#pdf("20250512_COLOSSUS_PNI_metabolites_protein_1000_iterations_histogram_0.5_frequency_plot.pdf")
ggplot(summary_stats_r, aes(x = n_hits_r)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 20, fill = "#67a9cf", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 500, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of Significant Interaction Counts (n_hits)",
    subtitle = "Dashed line = 50% threshold (500 hits)",
    x = "Number of significant hits",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
#dev.off()


# bubble plot

# Step 1: FDR adjustment
```

```{r}
#interaction_plot
library(interactions)

plot_interaction_with_p <- function(data, gene_col, pni_col, metabolite_col) {
  # Rename columns internally for convenience
  data$Gene <- data[[gene_col]]
  data$PNI <- data[[pni_col]]
  data$Metabolite <- data[[metabolite_col]]
  
  # Fit interaction model
  lm_formula <- as.formula("Gene ~ status_relapse * Metabolite")
  lm_result <- lm(lm_formula, data = data)
  
  # Extract interaction p-value
  interaction_term <- grep("status_relapse:Metabolite", rownames(summary(lm_result)$coefficients), value = TRUE)
  interaction_p <- summary(lm_result)$coefficients[interaction_term, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  p_label <- paste0("Interaction p = ", signif(interaction_p, 3))
  
  # Create plot
  library(ggplot2)
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Metabolite, y = Gene, color = as.factor(PNI))) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Interaction Between Relapse and", metabolite_col, "on", gene_col),
      x = metabolite_col,
      y = gene_col,
      color = "status_relapse"
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = p_label, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 5) +
    theme_minimal()
}

plot_interaction_with_p(
  data = combined_data,
  gene_col = "O15042_U2SURP",
  pni_col = "status_relapse",
  metabolite_col = "Myristic acid_228.21_2.92"
)
```
